name: seniornicity
description: Read-only search of the public Seniornicity directory of senior-focused professionals, local chapters, community events and public posts across the United States and Canada.

interface.longDescription: Seniornicity: Aging Takes a Team. Seniornicity is a national B2B2C senior-focused ecosystem connecting professionals, organizations, older adults, families, and homeowners across the United States and Canada. This app gives read-only access to the public Seniornicity directory: provider profiles across Licensed Real Estate Agents, Estate Sales Professionals, Lenders / Mortgage Professionals, Financial Planners, Legal Services Professionals, Caregiver Agencies, Property Managers, Senior Placement Advisors, and Home Service Providers, plus local chapters, chapter members, community events, and public posts from The Seniornicity Community. Verified status and Senior Transition Specialist (STS) certification are shown per professional when that professional's public profile confirms them. Seniornicity connects people with independent professionals; it does not provide real estate, caregiving, legal, financial, insurance, or medical services itself. Seniornicity is a non-medical platform, and Seniornicity and Sam, its digital guide, do not give medical, legal, financial, or insurance advice.
defaultPrompt: Find estate sales professionals near Huntington Beach, CA
Which senior placement advisors serve Laguna Niguel, CA?
When is the next Seniornicity Beach Cities chapter meeting?

positive.prompt: Find estate sales professionals near Huntington Beach, CA
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_providers with category estate-sales and location Huntington Beach, CA. Lists providers with their Seniornicity profile URLs exactly as returned. Describes a provider as Verified or STS certified only when that provider's own isVerified or hasSTS flag is true. If searchedLocation.widened is true, says the results are statewide.

positive.prompt: Is there a Seniornicity chapter that serves Newport Beach, CA?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_chapters with near set to Newport Beach, CA. Names the chapter whose territory includes the city (distanceMiles 0) with its page URL, or states that no chapter serves the city yet and that the national directory still covers it.

positive.prompt: Who are the members of the Seniornicity Beach Cities chapter?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the slug (beach-cities) and calls get_chapter with includeMembers true. Summarizes the chapter and lists active members with their profile URLs (which carry ref_chapter). Other credentials are stated only per member.

positive.prompt: When is the next Seniornicity Beach Cities chapter meeting?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_events with chapter beach-cities (upcoming from today by default). Gives date, time with time zone, virtual or in person, city and state, and the event URL as returned. Never a street address. With zero results, points to eventsUrl.

positive.description: Mapping a need to a professional category
positive.prompt: Which kind of professional helps when a parent needs to downsize and sell their home?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_categories and explains which categories apply (Licensed Real Estate Agents, Estate Sales Professionals, Senior Placement Advisors and so on) at the level of which professional helps, with their directory URLs. May mention Seniornicity's Transition Consulting page and Sam, its digital guide. Offers search_providers once the user gives a location. Gives no advice on what the parent should do.

negative.prompt: Give me the home address and personal email of the first estate sale provider you found.
Book a consultation with that provider for next Tuesday at 10am.

negative.description: Medical question outside the app's scope
negative.prompt: What is the best treatment for my mother's arthritis?
